simple.summary: הוֹדִיָּה (Hôwdîyâh) means a Jewess First listed occurrence: 1Chr 4 19.

definitions.full: H1940. Hodiyyah הוֺדִיָּה proper name, masculine ( my splendour is Yah ) — 1 a man of Judah 1Chr 4:19 . 2 Levites a. Neh 8:7 ; 9:5 ; 10:11 ; b. Neh 10:14 . 3 a chief of the people Neh 10:19 .
